name: Oaken Soul (Legendary Druid Archetype)
body:
Trees are not only nourished by water, soil, and sun. They are also nourished by the forces of life itself: love, beauty, laughter, passion, and the many things that living creatures experience. The oak, in particular, is fed by wisdom, and it keeps that resource within its wood. Those with an affinity for the tree can receive a form of wisdom uncommon even amongst druids.

Base Attack Bonus

The oaken soul has a base attack bonus equal to a wizard.

Skills

The oaken soul adds all knowledge skills to their class skill list. This modifies skills.

Hit Dice

The oaken soul has d6 hit dice.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

The oaken soul is proficient with the following weapons: club, dagger, dart, quarterstaff, sickle, and shortspear. They are also proficient with all natural attacks (claw, bite, and so forth) of any form they assume. The oaken soul does not have proficiency with any armor or shields.

This modifies weapon and armor proficiencies.

Protective Spirits (Su)

The oaken soul is protected by spirits who keep them safe from harm. The oaken soul adds their Wisdom bonus (if any) to their AC and CMD. In addition, they gain a +1 bonus to AC and CMD for every 4 class levels they have, up to a maximum of +5 at 20th level. These bonuses apply even against touch deals 1d6 + the wyrmkin’s Constitution modifier damage. The damage type is determined by the wyrmkin’s exemplar dragon. This breath weapon can either be a 15 ft., cone or a 30 ft., line, and the wyrmkin must wait 1d4 rounds after using their breath weapon before using it again. Creatures caught in the blast may make a Reflex saving throw against a DC of 10 + the wyrmkin’s Con modifier + half their class level. Success halves the damage.

At 4th level and every four levels afterwards, the damage of the wyrmkin’s breath weapon increases by +1d6 damage. Wyrm breath is treated as the wyrmtouched’s draconic breath weapon racial trait for the purposes of feats and other abilities which require it. The wyrmkin qualifies for breath feats. If the wyrmkin has another breath weapon of the same damage type and shape, when they use that breath weapon they may add the damage from this weapon to it. This includes spells that duplicate breath weapons, such as dragon’s breath.

Draconic Resistance (Ex)

You gain resistance to your exemplar dragon’s damage type equal to twice your class level. At 16th level, this becomes immunity to your exemplar dragon’s damage type.

Bond of the Dragon: When the wyrmkin chooses the bond of kinship as their bond, they may choose to have a legendary drake companion instead of an animal companion.

Druidic talents

The following talents are available to druids with this circle: attacks or when the oaken soul is flat-footed. The oaken soul loses these bonuses when they wear any armor or when they carry a shield.

Fruit of the Oak Tree (Ex)

The Oaken Soul may use Wisdom in place of Intelligence for all knowledge skill checks.
